push.title: W 2-0 vs Foursome | You: 8.0
push.body:
An 8.0, buddskees. You did your job and then some. That's the kind of teammate folks want.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Foursome, your 2nd straight match scoring. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.
+ Man of the Match, your 21st for us. Frame it, then hang it where your mama can see it.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after PhogsToffees walked off. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ 12 completed passes: +0.3. The kind of thing nobody notices except me and the rating.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted (down from your usual 2). Try it this way: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. Little by little.
- You and Soup_Kitchen22 were both flagged for defensive work rate. Fix it as a pair: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Mind this: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- 4 misplaced passes: -0.1. Low-hanging fruit.

Back-garden drill: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

buddskees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: The best time to plant a tree was yesterday. The second best is next match.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but they were laying bricks every hour. - Coach Lasso

Soup_Kitchen22, one more thing before you log off: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

Bring that energy back next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-0 vs Foursome | You: 6.5 (2nd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.5 against Foursome. The comeback story starts on nights exactly like this one.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ You and buddskees were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after PhogsToffees walked off. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ 2-0 against Foursome. A win's a win, and this was a good one.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted (down from your usual 3). Here's how: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. Biscuits if you nail it.
- Rating came in 0.8 below what your on-ball stats earned. Little adjustment: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press. Trust me on that one.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 2. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- You and Soup_Kitchen22 need to sync up on on-ball involvement: make triangles, 1-2 touch.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 50% (6 of 12). That's the first thing we fix, before anything else. Homework: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

Session plan: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Remember, tuxedo_slide: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

The comeback starts now. - Coach Lasso
